criteria.2: unit gain > 2 SE (SE over strategic pulled team-games)

dependence: 2026 weeks 13-18 are R1's, R2-H1's, R3's and R4's registered games and 2027 is R4's, so R5 takes the 2028 regular season, which no registered window and no development set has seen (C3-N reads 2027 for the deep engine; nothing coaching reads 2028). R5 is R4 with two changes; its unit statistic conditions on the real pulls, so it does not depend on R4's verdict, but both are built on R3's pull and R4's labels: a defect there is shared. R5 was fitted on 2016-2024 (second unit) and 2016-2025 (hazard); 2025 and 2026 weeks 1-12 were read in development, including the season-by-season corner that motivated the regime candidates, so no development figure is a test. Any change to an R5 file or to an R1-R4 file it plays on fails the pinned hashes and moves R5 to fresh games under a new registration.
power: Development, 2025 / 2026 weeks 1-12 (the second unit fitted on 2016-2024 only): +1.34 / +1.51 nats a strategic pulled team-game over R4 (SD 2.68 / 2.62; z 3.8 / 3.0). The 2028 window should hold ~45 strategic pulled team-games (424 in 2016-2024; 57 in 2025): SE ~0.40, power ~0.91 at +1.34, ~0.37 at half of it; at the 30-game floor ~0.77. Hazard guardrail: development gain +0.0007 +/- 0.0024 a team-game (2026), so with no true difference criterion 3 fails ~2.3% of the time. Corner secondary: R5 expects ~4.5 pulls a season there, critical count 9 (one-sided 5%); power ~0.71 if the 2022-2026 excess (x2.3) persists, ~0.24 at x1.5. Power is the chance the test passes IF R5 is better by the stated amount, not the probability that it is.
secondary: reported, never part of the verdict: the trailing corner's real pulls against R5's expectation, one-sided Poisson P(X >= real) < 0.05 = the post-2021 excess persists on fresh games (the evidence a corner-specific term would need)

settings.files: play_by_play_2028.csv.gz, players.csv, injuries_2028.csv in the read's directory (nflverse, fresh); the kind of pull is R4's classifier (descriptions, the next week's report; week 18's from the descriptions alone)

statistics.hazard: nfl_coach_r5_eval.hazard_score over every team-game: the pull's log loss, R4's (R3's hazard) minus R5's, per team-game (positive = R5 better)
statistics.unit: nfl_coach_r5_eval.unit_score over every strategic pulled team-game in the window (nfl_coach_r5_fit.unit_rows): log-likelihood of the lead back's and the top two targets' touches after the pull, R5 minus R4 (positive = R5 better)

what: the second unit after a STRATEGIC quarterback pull as drawn per-player decisions (the lead back sits with q_b, each of the top two targets with q_w given the back's decision, a player who plays at his season share shifted by d) against R4's per-snap odds; R3's hazard form refitted on 2016-2025 (every richer form was refused) as a guardrail; the trailing corner R3 missed as a registered secondary
